video_caption: Two men are seated in a studio setting, engaged in a conversation. The man on the left, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and purple patterned tie, has light brown hair and is actively speaking, often smiling and using hand gestures. The man on the right, wearing a dark brown jacket over a plaid shirt and glasses, is listening and occasionally nodding. The background behind them is split vertically: the left side is a dark, plain backdrop, while the right side features a blurred image of a gothic-style clock tower. In the bottom right corner of the screen, the text "UNIVERSITY of OTAGO" is displayed.

A man with short, light brown hair, wearing a dark suit, a white shirt, and a purple tie with yellow polka dots, is seated and speaking directly to the camera or an off-screen interviewer. He has a serious expression throughout most of the clip, occasionally making slight hand gestures to emphasize his points. From 00:33 to 00:41, his hand gestures become more expansive, with both hands open and raised as he talks. The background behind him consists of two panels: the left is a dark, blurry blue, while the right features a blurred image of a tall, dark architectural structure, possibly a clock tower, against a dark sky. In the bottom right corner of the screen, the white text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" (University of Otago) is displayed, with "UNIVERSITY OF" above "OTAGO," where the "O" in Otago is stylized.

The video opens with a man wearing glasses, a plaid shirt, and a dark blazer, speaking and gesturing with his right hand. He is seated against a blurred background featuring a dark sky and a prominent architectural structure, likely a clock tower. The scene then cuts to a second man, dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a dark patterned tie, who is also speaking and gesturing expressively with both hands. His expression appears serious and engaged. Throughout the segment, a white logo with the text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video opens with a man in a dark suit and a polka-dotted tie, laughing heartily, then shifting to a more serious expression as he gestures with his right hand while speaking. He is then replaced by another man wearing glasses and a dark blazer over a plaid shirt, who smiles faintly and nods. The first man returns to the screen, speaking intently and using both hands to gesture, conveying a serious tone. The second man reappears, looking thoughtful and then offering a slight smile and nod. Throughout the segment, the background remains a blurred image of a building, likely a university, featuring a prominent clock tower. In the bottom right corner of the screen, the text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" is displayed.

The video segment features two men engaged in a discussion or interview, seated against a dark, blurred background of a tall, gothic-style building, likely a university, indicated by the white "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" logo in the bottom right corner. The first man, visible from 0:00 to 0:07 and again from 0:29 to 0:34, has short light brown hair, wears glasses, a brown blazer, and a plaid shirt, and is speaking with subtle hand gestures and an engaged expression. The second man, seen from 0:07 to 0:29, also has short light brown hair, is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a dark spotted tie, and actively gestures with his hands, at one point pinching his fingers together and then opening them, while maintaining a serious and focused expression. The video alternates between close-ups of each man as they speak.

The video opens with a medium shot of an audience in what appears to be a lecture hall. In the foreground, a young man with glasses and a dark jacket speaks, gesturing with his right hand and looking slightly upwards. Next to him, another young man with glasses and a striped shirt listens intently, also looking upwards with a neutral expression. To the far left, a young woman in a dark jacket and an orange top rests her chin on her hand, looking forward. Several other blurred figures are visible in the background. In the bottom right corner, the text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" is displayed. At 00:17, the scene cuts to a different setting, showing a man in a dark suit and a patterned tie. He is speaking, making a brief gesture with his right hand towards his left shoulder before holding his hand up. He maintains a serious, thoughtful expression. The background features a large image of a classical building, possibly Parliament or a university, under a blue sky. The "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" text remains in the bottom right corner.

The video opens with a medium shot of a middle-aged man in a dark suit and a purple polka-dotted tie, speaking and looking slightly off-camera to his right with a serious expression. He briefly looks down before resuming his gaze to the right. In the bottom right corner, a white logo reads "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO." At the 00:10 mark, the scene cuts to an audience, featuring two young men in the foreground wearing glasses and casual shirts, both looking upwards and listening intently. Other audience members are visible but out of focus in the background. The video then cuts back to the man in the suit at 00:12, who continues to speak, making small, illustrative hand gestures with his right hand while maintaining a focused expression. The "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" logo remains visible.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a man in a dark suit, white shirt, and patterned tie, gesturing with both hands as he speaks with a serious expression. The background is a blurred image of a building, and the bottom right corner displays a white logo reading "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO". The scene then transitions to a wider shot, revealing the man in the suit is seated in a wooden chair, facing another man. The second man, wearing a dark jacket over a plaid shirt and glasses, is also seated in a wooden chair, listening intently. Behind them, an audience is visible with their backs to the camera. The background is a blue screen with a blurred image of a building, likely part of the university. The camera cuts back to a close-up of the man in the suit, who continues to speak and gesticulate. This is followed by a close-up of the second man, who listens and occasionally touches his chest with his hand. The clip concludes with a final close-up of the man in the suit, still speaking.

The video segment features two men in conversation, seated in front of a blurred background depicting a gothic-style building, likely a university clock tower, with "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" (and its logo) displayed on the right. The first man, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and purple-and-gold polka-dot tie, speaks expressively, using hand gestures to emphasize his points. He mentions a struggle with his economics team regarding tertiary policy and a compromise, explaining his desire to ensure students were not disadvantaged, universities kept pace with inflation, and post-doctoral scholarships, which he considers a "huge mistake" to have been cut, were addressed. The second man, wearing a brown blazer, a plaid shirt, and glasses, listens intently, occasionally interjecting with a smile and a comment, such as "And you lost on that one," to which the first man laughs, and later noting that their time is almost up. The camera cuts between the two speakers as they converse.

In this video segment, a man with short, light brown hair, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and a dark tie with light dots, is seated and speaking. He makes a downward gesturing motion with his right hand as he talks, his expression serious and engaged. Briefly, another man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a brown jacket over a plaid shirt, is visible to the right of the first man, smiling slightly and making a quick hand gesture as if reacting to what is being said. The background features a blurred image of a dark, tall building or tower, possibly a clock tower, and the text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" appears in white in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video features two men sitting and conversing, likely in a studio setting, with a blurred image of a gothic-style building, possibly a clock tower, in the background. The man on the left, wearing glasses, a plaid shirt, and a dark jacket, listens intently, occasionally offering a slight smile. The man on the right, dressed in a dark suit, white shirt, and a spotted tie, speaks animatedly, using hand gestures to emphasize his points. Both appear engaged in the discussion, which seems to involve political or social commentary. In the bottom right corner of the screen, the text "UNIVERSITY OF OTAGO" is visible, indicating the affiliation or host of the program.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a man wearing a brown jacket, a plaid shirt, and glasses, looking to his left and speaking with a slight smile. The scene then cuts to a close-up of another man in a dark suit, white shirt, and purple spotted tie, listening intently. These alternating close-ups continue as they engage in conversation, with the man in the suit using hand gestures while speaking and the man in the plaid shirt nodding and listening. At the 00:50 mark, the shot widens to reveal a panel discussion setting: the two men are seated on elevated chairs facing each other, with a small table and a glass of water between them. Two women are seated to the right, also facing the speakers. An audience of about 15-20 people, diverse in age, is seated in rows, watching the discussion. The background is a large screen displaying a blurred image of a historic clock tower or building, with the text "UNIVERSITY of OTAGO" clearly visible in the lower right corner, appearing consistently throughout the segment.

The video opens with a wide shot of an interview setting featuring two men seated on chairs facing each other, with a small table and water glass between them. The man on the left wears a dark suit and a patterned tie, while the man on the right wears a plaid shirt, a dark jacket, and glasses. An audience of about fifteen people, mostly young adults, is seated behind them, along with a woman in a light blue top on the far right. The background is a large screen displaying a blurred image of a building with a clock tower, likely part of a university campus, and the "UNIVERSITY of OTAGO" logo in the center. The camera then cuts between close-ups of the two men as they speak and listen, often gesturing with their hands and smiling, with the same background visible. The man in the suit speaks first, then the man in the plaid shirt, and they continue this back-and-forth. At 01:12, the wide shot returns as the two men shake hands, and the audience, including the woman on the right, applauds. A semi-transparent title card then overlays the scene, displaying the text "VOTE CHAT 2011 Conversations with politicians" (referring to a political discussion series from 2011). Below this, "DAVID SHEARER Interview with Dr Bryce Edwards" is shown, accompanied by a photo of David Shearer and a red "Labour" rosette badge. The background behind the text changes to a black and white architectural drawing. Finally, the video transitions to a blue screen displaying the "UNIVERSITY of OTAGO" logo and the website "www.otago.ac.nz".
